title: OccupancySnapshot
description: One 30-minute snapshot of free-space counts for a single parking lot.

time.description: Snapshot timestamp in UTC (ISO 8601). Snapshots are roughly evenly spaced at 30-minute intervals with up to ~1 minute jitter.

free_spaces.description: Number of free spaces reported by the upstream API at this moment (the common, non-accessible pool). Not bounded by parking_spots.common_spaces: it exceeds the declared capacity in 116,327 rows (2.5%, 55 lots), either because capacity was re-declared later or because the upstream counter glitched. Preserved as published.

free_handicapped_spaces.description: Number of free accessible spaces reported by the upstream API. This counter is the least reliable column in the dataset: it exceeds the declared accessible capacity in 94,435 rows (2.0%, 36 lots) and peaks at 9,979 free accessible spaces in a lot that declares 2 (lot 71, 17 June 2026). Preserved as published - do not treat it as bounded by handicapped_spaces.

occupancy_rate.description: Percent of *common* (non-accessible) spaces occupied at this moment, computed by the collector as (common_total - common_free) / common_total * 100, where common_total is the capacity for regular spaces declared AT THE TIME OF THE SNAPSHOT (excluding handicapped). Normally 0-100, but 19,792 rows (0.42%, 27 lots, 18 May - 9 Dec 2025) are negative, down to -1000: before January 2026 the collector did not clamp common_free to common_total, so a lot reporting more free spaces than it officially has produced a negative percentage. No row after 9 Dec 2025 is affected. Filter occupancy_rate >= 0 for a clean scale. NOTE: this is NOT 1 - free_spaces / total_spaces - that computation would also include handicapped spaces in the denominator. It also cannot be recomputed from parking_spots.common_spaces, which carries only today declared capacity: 74 of 190 lots re-declared capacity over the 19 months.
